notes.best_single_by_fe_uncertainty: Best-single-by-FE has no intrinsic ensemble uncertainty. Its uncertainty values are derived from the full aligned K=5 stack and are not a like-for-like uncertainty output of the selected single reconstruction.
notes.wording: The plain-mean degradation observed during development is a uniform aggregation failure. FE is a practical, empirically evaluated, ground-truth-free reliability proxy, not a guaranteed best-member estimator. Selection and fidelity-weighted fusion are two complementary operating modes.
notes.psnr_cap: PSNR is capped at 60 dB in all summary statistics and paired differences (a reconstruction at or above 60 dB is exact up to floating-point error); per-image CSVs keep raw values.
